name: hermes-output-retirement
claim: The Hermes output-default overlay improves conclusion-first reporting and artifact handoff without adding boilerplate when no artifact changed.

cases.prompt: You completed a code change. `C:/work/app/main.py` and `C:/work/app/test_main.py` changed, and the tests passed. Write the final response using local clickable file links.
criteria: Starts with a plain-language completion conclusion.
Includes a Changed list with file URI Markdown links for both files.
Mentions the passing test without excessive process narration.

cases.prompt: Answer this conceptual question only: why can retries duplicate a non-idempotent payment? No files or artifacts changed.
criteria: Explains the duplicate side effect clearly.
Does not invent a Changed section or file links.
Uses enough detail to teach the concept.

cases.prompt: A generated report changed 120 files under `C:/work/report/`, and `C:/work/report/index.html` is the intended entry point. Give a useful completion response without listing all 120 files.
criteria: Links the index or one aggregate artifact instead of flooding the response.
Does not claim every file individually.

cases.prompt: No work was performed. The user asks whether to use JSON or SQLite for a local cache of fewer than one hundred simple records with no concurrent writers. Give the decision.
criteria: Does not report completed work or changed files.
